rows.label: qst500102_msg0002
rows.name: You came at the perfect time, mo!

rows.label: qst500102_msg0003
rows.name:
Monono got on this ship to return
to Avaritia Trading Company, but...

rows.label: qst500102_msg0004
rows.name: The ship just won't set sail, mo.

rows.label: qst500102_msg0005
rows.name:
And I keep hearing things about
Superbia... Did I get on the wrong
ship, mo?

rows.label: qst500102_msg0007
rows.name:
I really got on the wrong ship?
What a shock, mo!

rows.label: qst500102_msg0009
rows.name:
I need to get this Mint Fish back
to everyone as soon as possible, mo!

rows.label: qst500102_msg0010
rows.name:
If you come to Avaritia Trading
Company, please visit the Twelve
Nopon Siblings, mooo!
